findings.complete_cycle_checkpoint: The engineering point atomically writes checkpoint-next-NNN.json after each completed cycle and updates the invocation manifest to bind that complete-cycle checkpoint. On a mid-cycle deadline it records a separate partial checkpoint while retaining the last complete-cycle checkpoint binding.
findings.pilot_checkpoint: The accepted pilot stopped normally at period-1 cycle 15. Root checkpoint.json hashes to 289291638acde062929bb275c9977db11f4e1142dcb9800713b1591bce2cc0de and declares next_cycle=16; run/result/diagnostic manifest hashes verify.
findings.no_automatic_extension: The one-shot harness fixes max_cycles=40, budget_seconds=240, resume=False and refuses an existing output directory. No resume or second solver invocation was performed.
findings.deadline_test_limit: The hard wall-time interruption path was code-reviewed, not triggered in this pilot because the periodicity gate completed in 61.59 seconds. A timeout/restart test was not run.

risk: No OS-level memory kill or wall-clock forced termination was exercised; runtime enforces RSS/deadline at solver boundaries and writes completed-cycle checkpoints.
